mu_name_from: MuMain loads the second classes' bare bodies as MODEL_BODY_BOOT + MAX_CLASS + i from Data\\Player\\BootClass2{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp:121-127), and GetSkinModelIndex hands CLASS_SOULMASTER, CLASS_BLADEKNIGHT and CLASS_MUSEELF skins 7, 8 and 9 (_enum.h:3250-3252, CharacterManager.cpp:240-254): Class201 the Soul Master, 202 the Blade Knight, 203 the Muse Elf.
why_this_one: Sevina's class change (the user, 2026-10-04: 'second class quest where char beccomes second class with new skins'; 'MU's way': the second class's body under any slot left empty). docs/class-change-quest.md.

sheet_warning: Read off the .bmd, not guessed from the number: the Soul Master (201) names level_man022 and the Blade Knight (202) level_man01, as the first classes' sheets are named against their classes too (HelmClass01's sheet_warning).
